tour.doneBody: You now know how to use the platform. Keep going with the "First steps" missions on your dashboard.

welcome.title: Welcome! 👋
welcome.body: In under 2 minutes you'll learn how to use the platform. Follow the missions — in some of them, you click to move on.

menu.title: Your menu
menu.body: Use it to move between your courses, the ranking and, if you are an admin, platform management.

destaque.title: Your next step
destaque.body: This highlight shows the most important course for you right now — overdue and in-progress ones come first.

cursos.title: Your courses
cursos.body: All courses live here. Use the filters to see only in progress, not started or completed.

abrirCurso.title: Open a course
abrirCurso.body: Let's see what a course looks like inside.

indice.title: Course content
indice.body: Here are the steps: overview, lessons, quiz and certificate. You can go back to finished ones; the next ones unlock as you progress.

avancar.title: Move through lessons
avancar.body: Watched the lesson and checked the materials? Click Next to complete it. At the end come the quiz and your certificate.

irRanking.title: Ranking time
irRanking.body: Completing courses and getting quizzes right earns points and achievements.

ranking.title: Ranking
ranking.body: See your position, everyone's points and open the details to see achievements.

irAdmin.title: Administration
irAdmin.body: This is where you create courses, tracks and manage users.

novoCurso.title: Create a course
novoCurso.body: Start here: course details, cover, lessons with video and materials, and the quiz.

relatorios.title: Reports
relatorios.body: Track course completion, see who is overdue and export the data as CSV.

preferencias.title: Your way
preferencias.body: Switch language (Português, English, Español) and theme (dark, light or system) here at the top.

conta.title: Your account
conta.body: From your name you can change how your name appears, replay this tutorial or sign out.

validar.title: Validate certificate
validar.intro: Check whether a certificate issued by the Training Hub is authentic. The code is in the certificate footer, next to the QR code.
validar.validBody: This certificate was issued by the platform.
validar.invalidBody: Make sure the code was typed exactly as it appears on the certificate.
